pages.title: World storage
pages.text: Files live in the world’s simply_speakers_audios folder as UUID.mp3 or UUID.wav. Back up the folder and stop the server before editing its manifest.

pages.title: Manifest records
pages.text: audio_manifest.json maps each recording UUID to uuid, originalFilename, ownerUUID and durationSeconds. Set a player owner; unowned recordings cannot be selected.
